negative_findings.description: No dedicated fintech/payments trade association exists as an overarching body in North Macedonia. A comparative legal guide states there is no overarching trade association for the fintech sector; the closest organised bodies are the Association of Financial Companies (AFD/AFSANM, alternative lending) and the Chamber's Grouping of Non-Bank Financial Companies.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched in both mk and en for a payments/fintech association; only non-bank-lending and ICT bodies surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Payment institutions and e-money institutions have no single collective voice, so their reactions to draft payment rules must be tracked institution-by-institution or via MBA/MASIT/AFD proxies.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated, indexed 'position papers' or 'коментари на нацрт закони' section was located on mba.mk. The site's visible structure is За нас / Активности / SKIBOR / Финансиска едукација / Фондација; positions appear to be embedded in news items (соопштенија) rather than a document library.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fetched mba.mk members page and reviewed site sections; no consultations/position archive observed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must be full-text over the news stream rather than a targeted document feed, and older positions may be unrecoverable.

negative_findings.description: Canonical homepages for two chambers were not directly confirmed: Стопанска комора на северо-западна Македонија (inferred oemvp.org from the published info@oemvp.org address; oemvp.eu also appears in circulation) and Сојуз на стопански комори (inferred chamber.mk from its official Facebook handle; the seeded 'sso.mk' returned nothing).
negative_findings.result_summary: Only business-registry profiles (zk.mk, companywall.com.mk) and social profiles were retrieved, not the organisations' own sites.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Two significant pointer sources are recorded at low confidence and need a manual URL confirmation pass before scheduled collection.

negative_findings.description: No Albanian-language (sq) search terms were used in this pass, although the north-western chamber serves a largely Albanian-language business community and likely publishes in sq.
negative_findings.result_summary: Run scope specified mk and en only; sq association material therefore not searched.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Positions of Albanian-language business associations on draft financial rules may be entirely missed.

negative_findings.description: mchamber.mk serves the same content under two hosts (mchamber.mk and mchamber.org.mk) and under both modern paths (/mk/home/propisi_info/ID) and legacy ASPX query strings with embedded ASP.NET session tokens (e.g. (S(skf2aj...))). fic.mk shows the same ASPX pattern.
negative_findings.result_summary: Observed in multiple search results; not tested for canonicalisation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Session-bearing URLs are unstable and will produce duplicate or dead records unless normalised at collection time.

coverage_gaps.description: Merchant/retail lobbying on card acceptance costs, interchange and POS/fiscalisation obligations was found only via the Chamber's Trade Association; no independent retailers' federation or card-acceptance interest group was identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search mk for 'здружение на трговци', 'сојуз на трговци', 'мали трговци', 'провизии на картички трговци' and check the Chamber's Trade Association member list for a spin-off body.

coverage_gaps.description: Actual submitted consultation comments from associations (as opposed to news mentions that comments were submitted) were not located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cross-reference association news items against the national e-consultation register (ENER) and NBRSM/Ministry of Finance consultation pages, where submitted comments are more likely archived; this bridges to other workstream cells.

coverage_gaps.description: MASIT and Chamber member directories were only sampled (KIBS, CaSys) rather than fully enumerated; the full vendor/member ecosystem is unmapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Full crawl of masit.org.mk/en/members-en/ and mchamber.mk grouping member lists to build a complete payments-ecosystem actor map.

coverage_gaps.description: Association LinkedIn/Facebook pages surfaced repeatedly (MBA-adjacent, ecommerce.mk, FIC, Union of Chambers) and often carry position announcements before the websites do, but social channels were not systematically catalogued.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Register the official social handles of each association as secondary monitoring channels, noting platform ToS constraints on automated collection.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival strategy was established for association content; chamber PDFs (annual reports back to 2007/2010) exist but position documents on specific drafts appear ephemeral.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Seed a Wayback/local mirror pass over mba.mk, mchamber.mk propisi_info and afd.mk to build a historical baseline before ongoing monitoring starts.

brief: The association layer in North Macedonia is unusually concentrated: the Македонска банкарска асоцијација (mba.mk) is the single banking trade body and covers all 13 banks, both savings houses, and the two payment-infrastructure members (KIBS clearing house, Macedonian Credit Bureau), while the Economic Chamber's Здружение на финансиски организации (mchamber.mk) is the cross-sector venue where banks, insurers, leasing and non-bank lenders consolidate comments before submitting them to the Ministry of Finance. Around these sit specialised bodies — АФД for non-bank/fintech lenders, МАСИТ for the ICT and payment-technology vendors, Асоцијација за е-трговија for the online-merchant side, and AmCham/FIC for foreign-investor advocacy in English. The dominant collection challenge is that positions are published as news items and loose PDFs rather than in an indexed consultations archive, and the chamber sites use unstable legacy ASPX/session URLs across two hosts. Two chamber homepages (north-western chamber, Union of Chambers) remain URL-unconfirmed and no Albanian-language search was performed, both of which should be closed before scheduled collection begins.
